revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 5.6%, FY23-25 CAGR 5.4%; fade toward long-run defense budget growth given large backlog and rising defense spending.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2025 margin 7,731/75,048 = 10.3% (FY2023 12.6%, FY2024 9.9%; FY24-25 included program charges).

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. LMT effective rate (FY2025 pretax 5,922 vs NI 5,017 implies ~15% incl. FDII/R&D credits); 17% slightly conservative; Damodaran industry effective rate 11.6% for reference.

wacc.source: CAPM: rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.98 (Damodaran Aerospace/Defense unlevered cash-corrected 0.869, industry D/E 0.156, tax 15%) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US) = Ke 9.25%; pretax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran), after-tax ~4.4%; weights 86.5/13.5 -> ~8.6%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation-like growth, below risk-free rate 4.86%.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 21,700 (LTD 20,532 + current 1,168) - cash 4,121; no short-term investments reported; accession 0001628280-26-004195
